name: suricata_run
description: Run a named local Suricata rules file over a capture, enable JA3/JA4 TLS metadata, keep the complete EVE JSON and return bounded alert/metadata summaries that name the full output.

rules.description: A local Suricata rules file; no network rule download is performed

out_dir.description: An empty directory under work/ for eve.json and Suricata logs

return_alerts.description: Alerts returned inline (default 100); every alert remains in eve.json

checksum_mode.description: none (default, tolerates capture-offload checksums) or all (validate every packet checksum)
